facts.fact: Inara 决定尽快离开 Deadhaven——王室一旦得知 Fraener 出眠就会循消息而来
facts.anchor: she needed to get out of Deadhaven as soon as possible

facts.fact: 家中：Fraener 在屋旁闭眼休憩，但意识清醒地留在她的脑中
facts.anchor: could almost feel his consciousness wide awake and alert in her mind

facts.fact: 猎物连年减少，逼他们深入 Arelia 境内狩猎（有风险）
facts.anchor: the game had slowly started to disappear

facts.fact: Fraener 越飞越远，她的灵魂像绷到头的绳索般作痛——soul-link 的距离律
facts.anchor: The further he went, the more stained it became, like a tether reaching the end of its rope.

facts.fact: Boltix 百里内独家垄断熔金重铸生意，借机漫天要价
facts.anchor: He was the only one within a hundred miles who was willing to melt down and reforge stolen gold

facts.fact: 「绝不往南」是二人铁律；南方有他们都知道的危险，但 Gideon 的水债逼到眼前
facts.anchor: We don’t go south. We never go south.

facts.fact: 村民怕 Crowned Family 来收回巨兽想让龙走；Crowned Prince 被传闻是三国最危险的人
facts.anchor: rumoured to be the most dangerous man in all three kingdoms

facts.fact: Fraener 猎来烧焦的大兽放到她脚边喂她；她随后确认了 Fraener 之名（“It’s nice to officially meet you.”）
